_comment: An EXAMPLE of the file format ai_cli retrieval score reads. Not a golden set:
the ids are made up, and a real run's `retrieved` lists come from actually
running a retriever. This exists so the documented command is runnable, and so
the four cases worth understanding are visible in one file.
Run: cargo run --bin ai_cli --features full -- retrieval score docs/retrieval_run_example.json --k 4
